workarounds.note: each opener design starts with an empty box a whole number of grid lines deep (7 for the nameplate, 2 for the section flag) and hangs its rules from the box's foot. The opener then ends on a grid line and leaves no sliver of column beside it for 1.4.1 to rule down through (gotcha column-rule-through-opener). With the nameplate box 6.6 lines deep, the rule crosses the nameplate and the dateline
a :::space{lines=0.5} sits between the deck and the ::resource line in the front-page banner box, because a picture set inline inside a box gets no space above it in 1.4.1 (gotcha box-embed-no-gap)

col() writes each colour's hex beside its paletteId, because 1.4.1 does not apply colorPalette to design elements (gotcha palette-skips-designs). bodyText.boldColor is set to the ink too: referenceColor falls back to it and never gets the palette, and each callout body copies it before the palette is applied. Without it the two :ref labels on page 2 and the bold lead-ins of the four briefs print in #295AA3 blue

the H1 breakBefore is restated because any headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break). The present text fills page 1, so Town & Valley opens page 2 without it (same layout); the restatement guards edited copy
design text lineHeight is a multiple of the size (1 for the nameplate, 1.25 for the ears): a pt() value silently drops an opener's reserved height in 1.4.1 (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)

bodyText.maxRuntTracking is 0, so a runt fix never gives a paragraph the negative tracking 1.4.1 measures but does not paint (gotcha runt-tracking-unpainted). The present text triggers no runt fix; the setting guards edited copy

bodyText.boldColor is set to the ink, not left to main-color: each callout style copies bodyText.boldColor (or the default linked to main-color, #295AA3) into its body before the palette is applied, and the palette never recolours it, so the bold lead-ins of the four briefs would print blue
